Our client is one of New Zealand's most respected specialist engineering consultancies, delivering high voltage substation primary design for Transpower and electricity distribution businesses across the country. This is a rare opportunity to join a technically excellent team at the principal level — leading complex transmission projects, mentoring graduate engineers, and shaping outcomes on infrastructure that underpins New Zealand's energy future.

  • Cable modelling and cost estimation using Transpower's TEES system

  • Mentoring and technically guiding graduate and junior engineers
  • Identifying and supporting business development and tendering opportunities
Your Background
  • 15+ years' experience in HV primary design — NZ, Australia, or equivalent UK/international utility sector
  • Washington Accord accredited degree, BE(Hons) NZQF Level 8, or CPEng (CEng IET recognised)
  • Strong track record in transmission substation design and project delivery
  • Experience in a design consultancy environment advantageous
  • Skilled technical author with excellent report writing ability
What Makes You Stand Out
  • Hands-on Transpower or DNO-equivalent project experience
  • Commercial acumen — quoting, planning, accountability for project financials
  • Strong communicator with clients and multidisciplinary teams
  • Driven, detail-oriented, and able to work under pressure to tight timescales
  • High regard for safety by design and quality assurance

    Apply online or contact Matt Love-Smith on matt@talenthive.nz

job.title: Network Development - Senior Engineer
job.description:
A network planning role with real technical depth and genuine ownership.
Wellington Electricity is one of New Zealand's most technically distinctive electricity distribution businesses. A $893 million regulated asset base serving the capital region, a network unlike anything else in the country, 11kV and LV ring-mesh topology, oil and gas cable assets, and a long-term investment programme that's only getting more complex as energy transition accelerates.
This is a newly created Senior Engineer role inside the Network Development team. Considered a strategic investment in technical depth that will shape how Wellington Electricity plans, prioritises, and executes its network for the decade ahead.

The work
A genuinely broad planning role with direct influence on capital investment decisions. You'll lead load forecasting, run reinforcement and contingency studies in DIgSILENT Power Factory, develop long-term network options across traditional and non-traditional solutions, and translate technical constraints into defensible AMP and board-level recommendations. DG connections, technical approvals, and regulatory compliance are all part of the picture and you'll mentor the graduate and junior engineers around you.

What we're looking for
  • 7+ years of experience in distribution network planning at an EDB, asset owner, or equivalent
  • Strong DIgSILENT / Power Factory capability — non-negotiable
  • Load forecasting methodology and reinforcement study experience
  • Sound understanding of NZ electricity regulations (or a closely comparable framework)
  • Commercial judgement: the ability to assess risk and make a case for capital investment
  • Strong communication skills — comfortable translating technical work for non-technical audiences
  • A collaborative, flexible approach that suits a dynamic EDB environment
  • Degree in Electrical Engineering essential; chartered status supported if you're on the pathway
The package
  • Competitive remuneration package
  • KiwiSaver, insurance, and wellness benefits
  • Relocation support available for the right candidate
  • Flexible working environment
This search is managed exclusively by TalentHive on a retained basis.
If your background fits or you're simply curious then we'd welcome a confidential conversation.

matt@talenthive.nz | +64 3 281 8448 | linkedin.com/in/mattlovesmith

job.title: Principal Hydrodynamicist
job.description:
• Global leader in advanced and innovative marine propulsion systems
  • Specialist hands-on technical authority role
  • Full product lifecycle ownership  
Trusted the world over for their expertise and innovation, HamiltonJet represents the latest in efficient, robust, high performance propulsion technology.
Founded in 1939, they have delivered more than 60,000 waterjets to commercial, defence and recreational operators around the world to date.
HamiltonJet is in the final stages of opening a cutting edge production and engineering facility encompassing design, foundries, production and testing all located on one Christchurch campus.
This specialist engineering role is central to the ongoing success of the business. You will be the hands-on technical authority for turbomachinery and hydrodynamic design, at a time when HamiltonJet is strategically investing in the optimisation of its design and test capability.

TalentHive has been exclusively retained to lead this international search.

The role
Reporting to the Product Engineering Manager, you will join an advanced engineering group of senior engineers and analysts. Your time and expertise will be focused on:
  • Further developing and advancing design data and processes, building on a proven in-house design system alongside ANSYS CFD (Fluent and CFX)
  • Designing tests and validating performance, driving further development and optimisation of rig, test boat and data acquisition capability
  • Working with external test suppliers and critically assessing their methods and results
  • Mentoring engineers in turbomachinery design methods
  • Occasional international travel 
About you
  • 10+ years in industry as a turbomachinery practitioner, currently in a hands-on role with product responsibility
  • Deep expertise in incompressible, cavitating pump design. Marine propulsion, hydro, or liquid-fuel rocket turbopump backgrounds are of particular interest
  • A strong experimentalist who knows how to design tests and question data
  • Master's degree in mechanical, aerospace or marine engineering or similar; PhD preferred
  • Breadth and a hands-on attitude, with a preference for owning the whole problem over working in a narrow specialism
  • Valued but not essential: marine propulsion, hull integration, scientific programming (including Fortran), and data acquisition experience
Because of the company's defence customer base, this role is subject to security and export-control screening.
Why HamiltonJet
  • Full lifecycle ownership of products used around the world, from concept to sea trial
  • A senior role that will shape the next generation of waterjet design
  • Stability and long-term career prospects in a well-established, privately owned company
  • A competitive package with comprehensive international relocation support, KiwiSaver, professional memberships and conference support
  • The South Island lifestyle: mountains, coast and outdoor living, all within easy reach of Christchurch
How to apply
Apply with your CV, or contact Matt Love-Smith at TalentHive for a confidential conversation: matt@talenthive.nz. +64(0)221017007
All enquiries are handled in strict confidence.

job.title: Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
Maintenance Engineer, Day Shift or Night Shift
Rolleston, Canterbury | Full-time | Day and Night Shift positions available | Hourly rate
A well-established, family-owned timber processing and manufacturing business in Rolleston is looking for hands-on Maintenance Engineers to keep a busy sawmill and processing operation running at full capacity. Two positions are available, one on a Monday to Friday day shift and one on the existing night shift crew, so let us know which pattern suits you best. The site is one of the most automated of its kind in the South Island, with industrial robotics running on the manufacturing lines alongside traditional sawmill plant.
The Role
You'll check, maintain, and repair machinery across the sawmill and processing shed, including plant supporting the site's robotic manufacturing lines, working to a structured preventative maintenance programme and picking up fabrication work on special projects as needed.
Day shift runs Monday to Friday, 6am to 3pm. Night shift joins an established overnight maintenance crew, with the opportunity to grow into a leading-hand role guiding that crew over time.
What You'll Bring
  • A recognised trade qualification (fitter/turner, mechanical, or plant maintenance)
  • Hands-on plant or machinery maintenance experience in an industrial setting
  • Practical fabrication skills for repairs and project work
  • A strong safety mindset, including lock-out/tag-out discipline
  • Willingness and ability to work night shift
Why Apply
Join a stable, long-running operation with genuine variety, hands-on maintenance and fabrication work, and exposure to industrial robotics and modern automated plant most maintenance roles don't offer.
Apply now via the TalentHive website listing.

A rare chance to work hands-on with industrial robotics and automation in a stable, long-established business that's serious about investing in its plant, people and technology, with real scope to build a genuinely future-focused skill set.
